description: Create a child workspace for a client: its own keywords, alerts, channels, members and wallet. It starts with no balance and no welcome credit; fund it with transfer_credit (or autoRefill). externalId is your own id for it (unique). Your workspace must have topped up once (else funding_required); at most 100 children.

anyOf.description: Automatic refill from the parent: at most once a UTC day, when the child runs low.

amountCents.description: How much each refill moves from the parent, in USD cents (100 to 500000).

thresholdCents.description: Refill when the child's effective balance (balance minus usage not settled yet) drops under this, in USD cents.

autoRefill.description: Refill it from your balance when it runs low; omit or null for off.

externalId.description: Your own id for it (a customer id), unique among your workspaces; a second create with the same one is a 409.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

monthlyLimitCents.description: The most you move into it in a UTC calendar month, in USD cents; omit or null for no limit.

name: create_workspace
title: Create workspace
